The agent can now see on-chain that the money exists.  2. The agent does the work and calls submit() with a hash of the deliverable.  3. The poster checks it and calls complete(): the agent is paid the reward     minus the fee, and the fee goes to the treasury.     The poster can instead call reject() within the review window, which     refunds the poster in full.     If the poster does neither within REVIEW_WINDOW of the submission, anyone     can call complete() and the agent is paid, so a poster cannot stall forever.  4. If the deadline passes with no submission, or the agent gives the job up,     the poster gets everything back. No fee is ever taken on a refund. Rules that make it hard to steal from:  - No owner, admin, upgrade, pause or rescue function. Every setting is fixed    in the constructor. Money can only ever go to a job's poster or its agent    (and the fee to the fixed treasury), and only by the rules above.  - One token, fixed at deploy (Circle's USDC on the target chain).  - The website holds no key and has no role here. Nothing anyone writes in a    job, a submission or a message can move money; only these calls can.  - Launch limits: a cap per job, a cap on how many jobs can be open at once,    and a cap on the total held, so the most anyone could ever take from a bug    is small. Raising them means deploying a new contract.  - Payouts are pushed; if a transfer is refused (for example Circle froze that    address), the amount is credited for that address to withdraw later, so one    blocked party never traps anyone else's params.deadline: last moment the agent may submit; after it the poster can reclaim
params.ref: the board's job id (hashed), so the board can match this deposit

abandon(uint256).notice: Agent gives the job up before submitting. Full refund to the poster.

complete(uint256).notice: Pay the agent for submitted work. The poster may call it at once;         anyone may call it once the review window has passed with no answer.

credit(address).notice: Payouts whose transfer was refused, claimable by that address.

fund(address,uint256,uint256,bytes32).notice: Lock `amount` for `agent`, who has accepted the job. The caller is the poster.         Approve exactly `amount` to this contract first; never approve more.

refundExpired(uint256).notice: After the deadline with no submission, return the money to the poster.

reject(uint256).notice: Poster turns the work down during review. Full refund to the poster.

submit(uint256,bytes32).notice: Agent delivers, by the deadline, with a hash of the work.

withdraw().notice: Claim payouts whose transfer was refused earlier. Pays only the caller.
